acceptance_criteria: Provider interface supports create, connection, inspect, export, and idempotent stop
Public manifests and recursive diagnostics never serialize connection or profile secrets
Fake provider tests cover success and every stable failure category
Cleanup preserves primary failures and reports cleanup failures separately
features.notes: Core contract passes; evaluator found behavioral injection coverage is not exhaustive for every declared stable failure category.

acceptance_criteria: Local sessions use unique state and artifact directories with pinned package metadata
Generated Playwright MCP configuration is exact-tested and fails loudly when prerequisites are absent
Concurrent isolation and cleanup paths are covered by hermetic tests
Opt-in live and capacity smoke commands are available without becoming CI dependencies
features.notes: Pinned provider and process cleanup pass; real two-browser cookie/local-storage isolation and 50-session deployment evidence remain pending.

features.description: Codex MCP vertical slice and lifecycle wiring
acceptance_criteria: Codex accepts per-task stdio MCP servers while non-browser arguments remain unchanged
Remote endpoint values travel only through child environment variables, never argv or prompts
Browser lifecycle cleanup runs on success, error, cancellation, and timeout
Browser manifests and artifacts preserve existing chain and stage identity
features.notes: Codex per-task MCP config, secret env forwarding, non-browser regression tests, capability validation, and process-tree ownership implemented.

acceptance_criteria: Browserbase create, connect, inspect, export, stop, and audit use an injectable bounded HTTP client
Stub tests cover auth, quota, malformed response, timeout, export, cleanup, and idempotent stop paths
Credentials and CDP material remain process-local and are absent from serialized session data
Live smoke and 20-session soak are explicit credential-gated deployment checks
features.notes: Browserbase REST/CDP adapter, stub lifecycle/error tests, idempotent stop, audit, and explicit live-test gate implemented. Live/Cloud Run soak not run because credentials are absent.

features.description: Eval integration, fixture, documentation, and repository gates
acceptance_criteria: Eval configuration selects local-playwright or browserbase without changing non-browser behavior
Results bank browser identity, termination, usage, artifacts, nullable cost, and neutral versus managed classification
Hermetic fixture and operator guide cover local and remote setup, cleanup, recovery, and capacity measurement
Repository test, lint, format, boundary, and file-size gates pass while unrelated worktree changes remain untouched
features.notes: Eval/CLI/docs/gates pass; fixture grader does not yet prove a Playwright-specific tool invocation, and live capacity/comparison gates remain pending.
